about: GitHub #46: realm ability descriptions that left out their training requirement.

entries.sql: UPDATE Ability SET Description = Description || ' Requires Augmented Acuity 2.' WHERE KeyName = 'AtlasOF_Serenity' AND Description NOT LIKE '%Requires%'
entries.why: GitHub #46: Serenity can only be trained with Augmented Acuity 2 (AtlasOF_SerenityAbility.CheckRequirement) but its description did not say so; the other abilities with a prerequisite end with 'Requires ...' (Mastery of Healing: 'Requires Augmented Acuity 2.')

entries.sql: UPDATE Ability SET Description = Description || '. Requires level 40.' WHERE KeyName = 'AtlasOF_StrikingTheSoul' AND Description NOT LIKE '%Requires%'
entries.why: the same gap as GitHub #46: Striking the Soul can only be trained from level 40 (AtlasOF_StrikingTheSoul.CheckRequirement) and its description did not say so
